verdict.rationale: Delegating to an AI assistant is a fair axis for a knowledge-management app like Anytype, but the evidence describes no assistant built into the product. What it does show is external agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot) acting on Anytype data through the local API, an MCP server and an agents skill. Its chat features are messaging between people, not an AI assistant, and the GitHub 'AI Agents (see AGENTS.md)' line is too vague to show an in-app assistant. Delegation to external tools does not meet the 'built-in' requirement of this story.
